status: Focused reporting-gap review; not a completed CLAIM checklist, score, certification or peer review
scope: Selected reporting topics compared with the current report, code and evidence records; original checklist wording is not reproduced

findings.assessment: Addressed in title/abstract and study design
findings.detail: Retrospective exploratory study; conventional pretrained convolutional networks; no clinical-use claim.
Original paper provides population and physician grading context. This project inherits labels, without independent adjudication or complete annotation instructions.
Preprocessing, frozen cohorts and exact-hash separation are explicit. Grouping uses filename proxies; no claim of verified clinical patient independence. No covariate imputation.
No independent de-identification audit, scanner/exposure/date metadata, reader-agreement estimates, or individual demographics for the retained cohort.
Available source data determine sample size; no prospective power calculation or confirmatory significance claim.
Standard torchvision models, newly initialized heads, all parameters fine-tuned, fixed hyperparameters, development-only selection, and equal-weight probability ensemble are documented.

findings.assessment: Reported for source experiments with bounded scope
findings.detail: Metrics, paired group bootstrap, seed/resolution comparisons, calibration diagnostics and frozen error overlap are available. Intervals omit training/selection uncertainty; no independent clinical error adjudication.
No saliency or validated localization claims. Dimension-only predictability does not show neural-model feature use.
Candidate source investigated; unresolved access/provenance statements prevent its use here. No external scores reported.
Retrospective public-data experiment with no patient enrollment or intervention. No trial registration claimed.

findings.assessment: Image counts reported; exclusion detail limited
findings.detail: Raw and retained image totals and partition counts reconcile. Development exclusions are an aggregate of overlapping criteria, not independently verified patient counts. Supplementary Figure S1 displays the image flow.
Source code and report are public; new weights remain in owner-access Kaggle outputs. Prior test inspection and clinical/generalization limits are explicit.

Funding, support and funder roles are not invented. Authorship, affiliations, conflicts, AI-assistance disclosure and applicable ethics determination also require responsible human verification before submission.
